meta.title: A malformed BOQ row is reported with its row number
gaps: Supply and upload a BOQ spreadsheet containing a bad quantity on row 12; upload supports only fixed sample fixtures whose contents cannot be configured.
Trigger and verify a readable error identifying row 12, and confirm either nothing imports or good rows import with the bad row listed.
Verify that the malformed upload does not return HTTP 500 without being able to perform that upload.
